name: Abyssal Vendetta
source:
Step into the shoes of Kris, a trans girl on a quest for revenge against her heart-breaking ex. After a wild night of drinking, Kris and her friends decide to summon a demon. Your choices shape the journey: will it end in a demonic romance, rekindled love with an old friend, or a chilling demise?

[From [url=https://narrative-nomads.itch.io/abyssal-vendetta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演跨性别女孩克里斯，向心碎的前男友报仇。经过一夜的疯狂饮酒后，克里斯和她的朋友们决定召唤一个恶魔。你的选择决定了旅程：它会以恶魔般的浪漫、与老友重燃爱情的火花，还是令人毛骨悚然的死亡而告终？

[来自[url=https://narrative-nomads.itch.io/abyssal-vendetta]Itch.io[/url]]
